longevity.rationale: The 4A-GE and five-speed held up in one original long-term test. Later-life corrosion and cooling coverage remain thin.

evidence.text: A period U.S. AW11 long-term test documented the original naturally aspirated configuration and single-car service experience.
The original U.S. supercharged road test compared the boosted and unboosted cars and documented the 1988 changes.
